rules: Components do not own business rules.
Validation comes from the domain validation engine.
Live preview uses the same domain/clause/render pipeline as the final document.
No clause editing UI in MVP.
Unresolved values use UI-only pending markers; never raw legal placeholders.
Any contract-affecting payload mutation invalidates prior approval and any unsent generated PDF.
External action components are disabled before HUMAN_APPROVED.
Confirmation of the review modal never performs external writes.
